artifact_observations.location: Handwritten text on the left and right pages
artifact_observations.reasoning: The handwritten numbers and letters show slight inconsistencies in form and alignment typical of AI generation. Some characters merge slightly or have irregular stroke widths, though they remain largely legible as a calendar grid.

The connection between the metal rings and the binder's spine mechanism appears somewhat vague and physically imprecise. The hardware lacks the sharp, engineered definition expected of real metal parts, showing slight melting/fusion into the paper holes.
The grid lines on the paper show minor waviness and inconsistent perspective convergence, particularly on the left page, suggesting a slight failure in maintaining rigid planar geometry.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is indeed a binder and not just loose papers or a notebook, verifying class alignment.
To rigorously audit the legibility and structural correctness of the handwritten numbers and words, which are prone to AI artifacts.
To check for fusion or bleeding between the metal rings and the paper holes, ensuring distinct physical boundaries.
To verify the planar geometry of the pages and ensure the depth relationship between the rings and paper is physically valid.

focus_areas: Legibility and consistency of handwritten text (numbers/days)
Physical plausibility of the ring mechanism and its attachment to the spine
Planarity and perspective consistency of the grid lines on the paper
Boundary sharpness between metal rings and paper holes
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the handwritten text. AI often fails to render consistent handwriting in grids. Check if the numbers follow a logical calendar sequence and if the character shapes are stable. Also, inspect the metal rings for 'melting' into the paper, a common artifact where hard materials lose their edge definition.
